context.body: The voice associated with Solomon recasts royal splendor as secondary to received wisdom.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The speaker prays and receives understanding, choosing wisdom over scepters, riches, health, beauty, and light.
observations.label: A royal voice prefers wisdom to wealth: action

observations.body: Wisdom arrives with other goods and becomes an unfailing treasure shared with others.
observations.label: A royal voice prefers wisdom to wealth: response

observations.body: prayed · wisdom came · preferred · riches came

payload.posture: Read Wisdom 7:7–14 as works bearing solomon’s name evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The passage celebrates wisdom as gift without identifying the speaker’s historical setting in this excerpt.
payload.title: A royal voice prefers wisdom to wealth
